title: Orreth common definitions
description: Shared primitives referenced by every Orreth contract. Source specs: design/0000-0006. ScopePath and Space are depth-agnostic by design (0000 §1) — tier names never appear in wire contracts.

DID.description: Universe-unique decentralized identifier, becky-issued (0006). did:web at roots, did:key at leaves.

ContentHash.description: Content address: sha256 of the canonical body (0001 §1).

Sig.description: Ed25519 signature over the canonical payload.

ScopePath.description: Slash-delimited path of typed segments, root first (e.g. 'u:acme/e:cloud/f:prod'). Depth-agnostic: the depth-3 cap is policy (0000 §1), not structure.

UniverseTime.description: The universe's own lived timeline (0004 §1, locked 2026-07-02) — declared by the universe, monotonic per scope (high-water enforced for provenance_class 'lived'). Replaces v0's EcosystemClock, which conflated lived time with wall time. For clock.mode 'wall' universes it tracks WallClock 1:1.

WallClock.description: Physical UTC time (0004 §1). Security and money live here: TTLs, co-signs, heartbeats, gateway ingest stamps. Meaning runs on UniverseTime; the locks rust on WallClock.

clock.description: Locked 2026-07-02 (0004 §7): queries and the pane's scrubber speak universe-time by default — the same time the memory means; 'wall' is the explicit ops/forensics escape hatch.

Space.description: Retrieval breadth — ScopePath-relative, never tier-named (0002 §3 as amended 2026-07-01).

Selector.description: Targeting for cascade and cohorts (0001 §4, made depth-agnostic: subtree targeting is by ScopePath, not tier name). A tier may target at-or-below itself only.

renew_days.description: The fuel clause's window (2026-08-22, JB-approved): tokens is an ALLOWANCE per this many days, refilled by the plane at each window turn on the meter's record. Absent or 0 = a lifetime lump.

StandardRef.description: Versioned reference to a Standard (policy, rubric, anonymization, pruning...).
